text:
StarvedSteve would like to welcome you to this clipboard bell thingy. This will have notifications for additions, updates and fixes, as well as report possible broken scripts when the devs update DST Mobile.

Tap the bell icon again or any empty space to close the notifications!

Updated commands to use long brackets as suggested. There's no longer need to turn off autocorrect and punctuation. I tested the longest command and the macro runner and they still work so everything would probably work just fine.
Quick link to move buttons in placer. It pastes the command automatically to the placer page! Removed outdated commands in placer.
Added (24) Stack and group up same items triggered on item drop. For the floor hoarders! Skips lightbugs and anything alive to prevent happy little accidents
Fixed (24) Grouper from grouping items with collision hehe

Added a (MISC) manual save command. In case anyone else is having a bug with disconnect button freezing(which leads to the game failing to save a day's worth of progress). Otherwise, don't bother using. DO NOT close the game before you see the save announcer.
Added (25) Prevent accidental attacks on your beefalo IF the bell it's bonded to is in your inventory or your backpack whatever body item storage. I hit my beef(again), so now this finally exists.
Added (MISC) One tap Console screen open. trying to also make it auto pull up keyboard automatically too if possible
Added (8.7) Macro Cleaner to attempt to clean up the macro with old duplicates or older commands with the old positions. Still experimental
Fixed (8.6) Forgotten labels and changed number range in cmd to placeholder
Added (27) Added Fig tree block growth range for easy spacing to plant several fig trees tightly packed

Added (28) Remove Insanity Visuals, Most of them anyway, the ground and brightness visuals is still there, idk if we can reach them with lua. This also removes most if not all nightvision tints while low/no sanity
Added (29) Remove Moggles Nightvision and day tint
Added (30) (31) Wanda Ageless&Backstep Watch quick use button, finds a ready watch then uses it. Button only shows up when there's an off cooldown watch
Fixed (26) Chatscreen Scrollbar | Will also let iOS stay on the chat screen after keyboard close
Added (32) Play gramophone indefinitely to keep nearby plants happy.

Added (33) Telepoof quick button and manual aim to telepoo(f). Now you dont need to equip the lazy explorer and be limited by the sad mobile exclusive range. Reticle always starts at the character, you can cancel by moving your finger back to the button

Updated (13.1) Character specific cmds to have custom tags for the new macro runner. Updated placer so checkbox affects the dynamic placer box. Added a note for character cmds for the filter. Total affected cmds are just 3, spellbook cmd will collide with Wanda's commands(breaking the spellbook) unless you delete(8.6) them and readd using the new (8.3)

Added (8.7) Recover from the most recent 8.6 deletion
Fixed (8.6) Placeholder to a truly magnificent number. Both have been tested
Updated (8.2) runner to check character and filter the character specific commands
Updated clipboard to have character counts to make it easier to identify which specific command you have in the list made by (8.5)
Updated (8.1) Use only once, to create the persistent string(macro) as this has no guards against read fails. Disregard if you already have a macro (ran 8.1/8.3s before)
Reordered some commands. Because I mistakenly added new commands at the bottom.
Added (34) Abby accidental attack prevention

Updated (21.2) The auto hitch used to try to unhitch and walk even when there's no hitching station, might as well lean in and just feed and mount on beef tap. It'll feed only one then mount, assuming it's already domesticated

Looks like (8.5) chat lister's char count is wrong but it does list the mode(local L or remote R) and a function next to it. For  this autohitch update, you can just find and delete 21.2s old cmd then run and save the new one if you like
Added (35) WX Scout drone icon when  one or both (shows 2)  are done exploring/idle

Added (8.5.2) a new "lister" that exports your current macro then lists it in a webpage instead, no more need for chatscreen+ using freepastebin. Removed outdated info when ntfy was used in test server
Added (8.5.3) Download your edited macro from browser. Why all this? Just to see if its possible. This and 8.5.2 can be called with just functions after setup and save

Added mw-compare.html. To use, run and save (8.5.2) and (8.5.3) using (8.3.2) - updated to not have a mw_macro check so cmds needing it will be saved. The new helper page can view/add/edit/delete/reorder the commands. To edit a command, Tap the L or R label on a command. Others should be self explanatory I hope
Updated (8.2) Runner to report skipped lines and total
Added (MISC) Hide UI by tapping hunger badge. Tap anywhere to undhide, this is for screenshots

Added (MISC) Zoom out further and remove leaf overlay, tap the heart badge to toggle. Happy little accidents by accidental taps is not my fault. You can probably change the max camera distance by increasing 120 to whether but don't if your device is old like mine. The initial zoom out every fresh load is plagued with clouds, zoom back in a bit. Like the other new misc, this is inteded for screenshots, like a megabase you made
